audit.method: Direct model translation followed by complete source-target editorial readings of the Harvey room, Sandy introduction, and Qi walnut-room events; the text-free Desert Festival defeat event was explicitly preserved. All twenty player-facing strings use canonical Stardew Valley, Oasis, walnut-room, and Qi Gem terminology. Event commands, actors, coordinates, movement, frames, timings, music, sound and cutscene IDs, gender selectors, placeholders, emotes, quoted-string boundaries, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.

records.preserveReason: The event contains only scene, actor, pause, lost-item display, and end commands; it has no player-facing English text.
